items.html: Thus, in that phase of the record of the Yesod of Arich, there is the phase of the shofar, and from there ZA emerged in the secret of voice, included in three: water, fire, and wind, in the secret of ‘the voice that comes forth from within the shofar.’ And there it was included, in the three aforementioned, in this throat, which was in a vacant and empty place, and there is nothing there but the phase of air alone; therefore it was called voice.
